description: This file contains unit tests for the AgentEventStore component, specifically testing append, clear, and trimming functionalities.

classes.name: AgentEventStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of AgentEventStore, including appending events, clearing events, and trimming to a maximum number of events.

methods.name: `append and clear`
methods.description: Tests appending events to the store and then clearing them to check the store resets correctly.

methods.name: `trims to max events`
methods.description: Tests that the AgentEventStore trims excess events beyond the maximum limit of 400, verifying the correct sequence of stored events.
